notes.title: Grounds of Glory servers are shutting down
notes.content:
It has been a fun ride for us. We learnt a lot. But Grounds of Glory was not as successfull as we had hoped.

We cannot keep it up anymore so we will be slowly shutting down the servers.

notes.title: Grounds of Glory is Free to Play Now
notes.content: We made Grounds of Glory Free To Play for everyone. There are no in-app purchases, just pure PvP. See you in the arenas!
